description: Trust framework for digital transport and logistics platforms in Sub-Saharan Africa, including ride-hailing (Uber, Bolt), delivery services (food, parcels), and freight/trucking platforms.
context_notes: Transport is the backbone of the economy. Digital platforms (ride-hailing, delivery) are transforming urban mobility and last-mile logistics. However, safety (accidents, crime), driver welfare (gig economy exploitation), and regulatory compliance (licensing, insurance) are major concerns. Road infrastructure is poor, traffic enforcement is weak, and insurance penetration is low.
